info.text:
An Amazon link can pay a creator up to 10% of your order.
Amazon counts a click for 24 hours (items added to cart in that window: up to 89 days).
Amazon standard rates (Oct 2026) run from 0% (gift cards) to 10% (luxury beauty); many categories pay 1-4.5%.
Example: $200 order in a 4% category = $8 to the creator. Your price is usually the same.
The FTC's Endorsement Guides (updated 2023) say creators should clearly disclose paid links.
Sources: Amazon Associates Central, FTC Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
